'''Oburun''' was a kingdom of the [[Third Age#Free Years|Free Years]]. It was founded after the end of the [[Trolloc Wars]], and was established on parts of the former territories of [[Aridhol]] and [[Aramaelle]]. It was later absorbed by the growing might of [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire]]. The lands it once held are now mostly uninhabited wilderness.

==Geography==
[[Image:Oburun.png|thumb|right|200px|In red location within the Westlands]]

Oburun was bordered by the [[River Ivo]] to the south, the [[River Arinelle]] to the west, the [[Plain of Lances]] to the north, and the [[Black Hills]] to the east. Its neighbors were [[Roemalle]] to the southeast, [[Masenashar]] to the south, [[Indrahar]] to the west, [[Basharande]] to the northwest, and [[Elsalam]] to the northeast.

==History==
Not much of Oburun's history is known, except it was conquered by [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall|Artur Hawkwing]] and made part of his empire. Some centuries after the [[War of the Hundred Years]], the area had become wilderness and is now unclaimed by any nation.
